goalkicker.question: Who's kicked the most goals in the AFL era?
goalkicker.askQuestion: Who has the most career goals since 1990?
goalkicker.answer: Lance Franklin, with 1,066 goals. Nobody has kicked more since 1990.
goalkicker.name: Lance Franklin

headToHead.question: Dangerfield v Dustin Martin, Brownlow votes by season
headToHead.askQuestion: Compare Patrick Dangerfield and Dustin Martin Brownlow votes per season from 2015 to 2020
headToHead.answer: Dangerfield won the 2016 Brownlow with 35 votes. A year later Martin won it with 36, three clear of Dangerfield.
